==> /etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml <==
advertise-address: 10.0.0.2
agent-token: the-token
bind-address: 10.0.0.2
flannel-iface: ens10
node-ip: 10.0.0.2
node-name: node1
write-kubeconfig-mode: "0600"

==> /etc/rancher/k3s/registries.yaml <==
mirrors:
    moostack.local:
        endpoint:
            - http://10.0.0.2:5000

==> /etc/systemd/system/k3s.service.d/memory.conf <==
[Service]
Environment=GOMEMLIMIT=4000MiB

==> /var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/etc/kubelet.conf.d/10-moostack.conf <==
apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
evictionHard:
    memory.available: 800Mi
kind: KubeletConfiguration
kubeReserved:
    memory: 650Mi
systemReserved:
    memory: 200Mi

==> /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/manifests/moostack-cert-manager.yaml <==
apiVersion: helm.cattle.io/v1
kind: HelmChart
metadata:
  name: cert-manager
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  repo: https://charts.jetstack.io
  chart: cert-manager
  version: v1.21.3
  targetNamespace: cert-manager
  createNamespace: true
  valuesContent: |-
    crds:
      enabled: true

==> /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/manifests/moostack-issuer.yaml <==
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata:
  name: moostack
spec:
  selfSigned: {}

==> /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/manifests/moostack-traefik-config.yaml <==
apiVersion: helm.cattle.io/v1
kind: HelmChartConfig
metadata:
  name: traefik
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  valuesContent: |-
    ports:
      web:
        allowACMEByPass: true
        http:
          redirections:
            entryPoint:
              to: websecure
              scheme: https
              permanent: true
    providers:
      kubernetesIngress:
        allowExternalNameServices: true
    deployment:
      kind: DaemonSet
    service:
      spec:
        externalTrafficPolicy: Local
